gloss: to be crowded; to be busy

definitions.gloss: to be crowded; to be packed
definitions.explanation: For a place to be densely crowded with buildings or people.

definitions.gloss: to be busy; to be swamped
definitions.explanation: To be occupied with many tasks or appointments in succession.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{予定|よてい}が{立|た}て{込|こ}んでいます。
{建物|たてもの}が{立|た}て{込|こ}んでいる{地域|ちいき}だ。
examples.english: It's an area densely packed with buildings.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{立|た}て{込|こ}んでいて{会|あ}えない。
examples.english: I'm too busy with work to meet.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{立|た}てる (to set up) + {込|こ}む (to become crowded)

TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予定|よてい}が{立|た}て{込|こ}む: to be swamped with appointments
- {仕事|しごと}が{立|た}て{込|こ}む: to be busy with work
- {建物|たてもの}が{立|た}て{込|こ}む: buildings are densely packed

NUANCE:
Often used to politely decline invitations or explain unavailability—implies being unavoidably busy.
